$comment: Parts and models for the Deep Mines and Core enemies, bosses and world bosses (builders_deep_core.py, variants in src/data/variants/deepCore.ts).

parts.prompt: Governor drone antenna: a gold mast with a glowing blue orb, a ring and two fins. Origin at the base, grows up.
Governor drone collar: a gold ring with four outward spikes and blue studs, worn round the drone body. Origin at the centre, axis up.
Miner hard hat: a yellow dome with brim, a ridge and a glowing headlamp on the front (+Z). Origin at the brim centre.
Drill arm: a rust-orange housing with a flange and a spiral steel drill bit. Origin at the base, grows up (+Y).
A bundle of four red dynamite sticks tied with a band, a fuse with a spark. Origin at the centre.
Crystal pauldron: a flat dark rock slab with three Lumen crystals. Origin at the middle of the slab, grows up.
Crystal spire: one tall Lumen crystal ringed by four shorter ones on a rock base. Origin at the base, grows up.
Crystal crown: a thin band with seven Lumen crystal spikes. Origin at the band centre, grows up.
Shard sac: three swollen glowing blue sacs with crystal shards bursting out. Origin at the base, grows up.
Burrower maw: a bone ring of eight inward curving teeth round a glowing throat, worn on top of the body. Origin at the ring centre, grows up.
Burrower armour: a ring of packed rock with crystal nubs, worn round the body. Origin at the centre, axis up.
Security helmet add-on: a glowing blue visor band on the front (+Z) and a blue crest ridge. Origin at the head centre.
Officer energy shield: a tall gold-framed plate with a glowing blue pane. Origin at its centre, faces +Z.
Shield generator backpack: a dark box with two glowing coils and an antenna. Origin at the centre of the back, faces away along -Z.
Armoured shoulder plate, security blue with a glow stud. Origin at the middle.
Armoured shoulder plate, gold with spikes (officers and governors). Origin at the middle.
Security chief peaked cap: a navy crown with a gold cord, a stiff brim on the front (+Z) and a gold badge. Origin at the brim centre.
Grenade bandolier: a strap across the chest with five grenades. Origin at the middle of the chest, faces +Z.
Lumen conduit pack: a dark backpack with three tall glowing cyan conduits and two cables to the shoulders. Origin at the centre of the back, faces -Z.
Echo glitch fan: five flat cyan blades fanned out like broken light. Origin at the root of the fan, spreads in the XY plane.
Memory tablets: five thin glowing slabs floating in a ring. Origin at the ring centre.
The Prism: a floating triangular bipyramid of white-cyan crystal with a thin ring. Origin at the bottom tip, grows up.
Elder halo: a large upright ring with eight glyph blocks, cold blue. Origin at the ring centre, the ring stands in the XY plane.
Elder monolith: a tall tapering slab of pale stone with glowing glyph bars. Origin at the base, grows up.
Drowned cables: four thick black cables drooping from the attach point, with dull glow tips. Origin at the top, hangs down (-Y).
Moss: a low mat of five dark green mounds with faint glow. Origin at the middle, grows up.
Shade halo: seven floating violet shards round a thin glowing ring. Origin at the ring centre, axis up.
Shade fan: five ragged violet blades fanned out behind the body. Origin at the root, spreads in the XY plane.
Shade crown: a thin violet band with nine long thin spikes, the middle ones tallest. Origin at the band centre.
Shade drift: five violet shards floating loose below and around the body. Origin at the middle, shards point every way.
Shade spine: a row of six violet shards leaning back, for a beast. Origin at the front of the row, runs back along -Z.
Shade wing: three long violet blades sweeping out, one of a pair. Origin at the root, spreads in the XY plane.
Violet conduit pack: a dark backpack with three tall glowing violet conduits. Origin at the centre of the back.
Armoured shoulder plate in violet metal with spikes. Origin at the middle.
Shade vines: four long violet vines hanging from the attach point with glowing tips. Origin at the top, hangs down (-Y).
Absorbed halo: a pale gold ring with nine radiating spikes of Lumen crystal. Origin at the centre, axis up.
Absorbed wings: four long gold crystal blades fanned out, one of a pair. Origin at the root, spreads in the XY plane.
Ostrow smith hammer grown in crystal: a long shaft and a heavy faceted head, gold-white. Origin at the grip, grows up.
Brother Lenn chef hat grown in pale crystal: a tall puffed toque. Origin at the base of the hat.
Halvorsen pump pipes: a backpack of three brass pipes with glowing valves. Origin at the middle of the back.
Rhee antenna dish: a mast with a shallow dish and a glowing feed, gold-white. Origin at the mast base, grows up.
Danner helmet grown in crystal: a dome, a glowing visor band and a crest. Origin at the head centre.
Choir crown: a pale gold band with seven tall spires round a bright pearl. Origin at the band centre.
Choir veil: four long pale ribbons trailing down and back from the attach point. Origin at the top, hangs down.
Stone crown: a band of rough stone with seven blunt grey spires and glowing cracks. Origin at the band centre.
Stone orbit: six rough rock blocks floating in a ring, each with a glowing crack. Origin at the ring centre.
Brood pods: three upright egg pods with hatch plates and exhaust pipes, glowing gold-green. Origin at the base, grows up.
Hollow ring: a heavy dark ring standing upright with violet glowing cracks and six blunt teeth round the hole. Origin at the ring centre, the ring stands in the XY plane.
Smokestack: a fat rusted chimney with a flared glowing ember mouth. Origin at the base, grows up.
Ash pile: three low grey mounds with a few glowing embers. Origin at the middle, grows up.
A row of five blunt rusted horns along the back, getting smaller. Origin at the front of the row, runs back along -Z.
Spore sacs: three swollen green sacs with glowing spots. Origin at the base, grows up.
Bracket fungus: three stacked shelf caps of pale fungus. Origin at the stalk, grows up.
Mushroom crown: a cluster of three domed mushroom caps on thick stalks, glowing spots. Origin at the base, grows up.
Echo Engine blades: five flat blue blades fanned out, dimmer than the Mines ones (the Core ground is pale). Origin at the root, spreads in the XY plane.
A floating triangular bipyramid of blue crystal with a thin ring, dim enough for the pale Core ground. Origin at the bottom tip, grows up.

models.prompt: Lumen turret: a hexagonal pedestal and column, a domed head with a crystal cannon pointing forward (+Z), two glowing side crystals, a tall antenna crystal and a floating ring. Built from primitives.

The Heart of Lumen: a huge faceted white-gold heart with two upper lobes and a crown of violet spires, held up by eight buttress roots and circled by two glowing rings and floating shards. Built from primitives.
